preconditions.expression: n == len(a) and all(0 <= x <= 2 * 10**5 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Input consists of an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5) followed by exactly n integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 2e5).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' if not exists(inc, dec) else (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(x in inc + dec for x in a) and len(inc) + len(dec) == n and all(inc[i] < inc[i+1] for i in range(len(inc)-1)) and all(dec[i] > dec[i+1] for i in range(len(dec)-1)))
postconditions.description: If no valid split exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by two sequences: a strictly increasing sequence (inc) and a strictly decreasing sequence (dec), such that their union is a permutation of the input sequence a, and all elements of a are partitioned between inc and dec.

postconditions.expression: exists(inc, dec) == (all(a.count(x) == (inc.count(x) + dec.count(x)) for x in set(a)) and len(inc) + len(dec) == n)
postconditions.description: The output sequences must exactly partition the input multiset a (counts of each element in inc + dec must match counts in a).

postconditions.expression: all(inc[i] < inc[i+1] for i in range(len(inc)-1)) if len(inc) > 1 else True
postconditions.description: The increasing sequence inc must be strictly increasing (or empty).

postconditions.expression: all(dec[i] > dec[i+1] for i in range(len(dec)-1)) if len(dec) > 1 else True
postconditions.description: The decreasing sequence dec must be strictly decreasing (or empty).
